_comment: Zelvryn population prior — default baseline for cold start user initialisation.
_description: Represents the statistical behaviour of a typical legitimate enterprise user. Built from anonymised aggregate statistics across a simulated population. Replace with a deployment-specific prior by running: python scripts/build_population_prior.py
_mean_action_vector_notes: Sums to 1.0. Typical enterprise user spends ~48% of actions reading, ~20% writing, ~17% searching. High-risk actions (export, config, admin) each below 4%.
_std_action_vector_notes: Standard deviation of each frequency component across the source user population. Higher std on read/write reflects natural variation in user roles.
_mean_interval_s_notes: Population-average inter-action interval in seconds. Reflects typical desktop navigation pace. Faster users (developers) average ~2s; slower users (executives reviewing docs) average ~10s.
_std_interval_s_notes: Population-average standard deviation of inter-action intervals. Humans naturally vary their pace; std ~3s is typical.
_median_adaptive_threshold_notes: Median cosine similarity anomaly threshold across source profiles. New users are initialised with this threshold. Their personal threshold is recalculated after 50 actions.
_n_profiles_notes: Number of real user profiles this prior was computed from. 0 = this is the system default prior. Run scripts/build_population_prior.py to build a deployment-specific prior.
_built_at_notes: Unix timestamp of last rebuild. 0.0 = never rebuilt (using defaults). A prior is considered stale after 7 days.
_deployment_context_notes: Descriptive label for the application context this prior was built for. Set to 'enterprise_saas', 'fintech', 'healthcare', etc. when building deployment-specific priors.
_action_types_notes: The 8 action types in their canonical index order. Must match UserAction.ACTION_TYPES in core/action.py.

cold_start_parameters._notes: New user profiles are seeded as if they had already performed this many actions matching the population average. Must be less than COLD_START_RAMP_ACTIONS (50).
cold_start_parameters._ramp_notes: Number of verified real actions before full enforcement begins. During ramp-up, cosine similarity check is disabled and ML threshold is raised.
cold_start_parameters._ramp_ml_notes: P(bot) threshold during ramp-up (more strict = fewer false positives on new users).
cold_start_parameters._ramp_temporal_notes: Temporal Z-score limit during ramp-up (looser = tolerates new user exploration timing).

rebuild_instructions.step_1: Ensure at least 10 mature user profiles exist in Redis (vector_count >= 20 each).
rebuild_instructions.step_3: The script reads all profiles from Redis via RedisProfileStore, computes aggregate statistics, and overwrites this file.
rebuild_instructions.step_4: Restart the API or call: GET /health — the new prior is loaded at next startup.
rebuild_instructions.frequency: Recommended: weekly cron job via Makefile target 'make rebuild-prior'.
